answer: Budget per identity: one TEE quote, one bond, one slot per epoch. A quote costs about 40 dollars a month, a bond 500 POA, and the slot pays at most one share, so 50 clones run 2,000 dollars a month in hardware against 50 shares. Disagreement dilutes the payout, so a split panel pays 0.5 a claim, and replay kills the second copy of a fable already on the lagoon ledger. The garden of real devices is small and costly.
